messages.subject: Error in if (inputs$use_detection_model == TRUE)  { :    argument is of length zero
parts:
Dear all, 

after having used BioGeoBEARS several times in the last two years, I´ve got stuck at the initial step. When I run "check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)", I always get this error message: "Error in if (inputs$use_detection_model == TRUE) { : argument is of length zero"
I will attach the required files if it is necessary. 

Thank you very much for your help.
PD: sorry if this error has already been dealt within this forum

Juancho

messages.author: 115d05260b0c341a
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in if (inputs$use_detection_model == TRUE) { : argument is of length zero
parts:
Hi -- the most likely issue is that you need to run all of the source() commands, after any time you do "library(BioGeoBEARS)".  The source() commands update the code with various patches and updates.

Cheers!
Nick
